messages:
anya: quick question — we need a compact way to show why an SLO alert did or did not fire in the console. specifically: thresholds, quiet windows, notify quota state, and fallback routing. thoughts?
ben: +1. users keep asking "why no page" even when the rule hit. UI should show the first matched rule and the reason it suppressed or routed.
carla: we also need to show quota checks. if tenant notify quota is exhausted, the console should display "notify quota exhausted -> routed to platform oncall" not just "suppressed". otherwise support gets smoke calls.
mike: agree. small suggestion: expose a single line reason with optional expand for details (eval timeline, which rule node matched, which fallback executed). e.g. "Suppressed (quiet window) — expanded shows windows and last trigger"
sophia: UX nit: avoid jargon like "fanout" in the compact row. use human phrases: "Sent to tenant notification service", "Rerouted to platform oncall" etc.
anya: implementation wise we need to decide shape of the internal API that console will call. current notify API returns a list of candidates and statuses  — might be too chatty. propose single consolidated trace object per alert with status enum + breadcrumbs.
ben: sample proto-ish shape:
```json
{
  "alert_id": "...",
  "status": "suppressed|routed|delivered|fallbacked",
  "reason": "quiet_window|quota_exhausted|route_mismatch|delivered",
  "breadcrumbs": ["matched rule X", "quiet window Y active", "fallback -> platform_oncall"],
  "quota_state": "tenant:exhausted|tenant:ok|global:ok"
}
```
carla: that's good. two asks: (1) keep breadcrumbs capped to 5 entries, (2) include timestamps for each breadcrumb so console can show the sequence.
mike: also include a small signal about noise-likelihood (low|medium|high) so console can highlight noisy rules in the editor. that will help product + SRE.
sophia: for rollout UX, when we change rule semantics we should show a "preview" that simulates routing for a sample of recent alerts so tenants can see impact before enabling.
anya: agreed — preview API should accept a lookback window and return N simulated evals with same trace object format.
devops-bot: config-deploy: notify-routing-service updated config notify_rules_v2 at 2026-03-21T15:04:03Z :white_check_mark:
ben: FYI: if we include quota_state in traces, console can add a CTA "request higher notify quota" next to alerts that were quota-blocked. lowers support churn.
carla: one more constraint: storage retention. these traces are helpful but high-cardinality. we should persist full traces for 7 days and keep a compact summary for 90 days.
mike: implementation plan: backend returns compact trace by default, console can request "full_trace=true" for the expanded view. keep default payload small.
anya: sounds like a plan. next steps: ben to draft proto + example responses, carla to add retention + quota UX sketches, sophia to mock compact row copy. I'll loop in product to confirm wording. thanks :)
